text.en: 1. This Notification is the Bus Services Industry (Designated Operating Entities) Notification 2025.

2.—(1) The LTA designates each entity specified in the first column of the Schedule as a designated operating entity.
(2) The designation of an entity as a designated operating entity takes effect on the date specified for that entity in the second column of the Schedule.
